name: Running With You
source:
Walking home after an exhausting day, you get cornered by three menacing looking thugs. And it seems that they want to kill you, but why?! However, just in time, two girls come to your rescue. Rely on one of them, to get out, but not without an unexpected romance.

[From [url=https://writer31.itch.io/running-with-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
结束疲惫不堪的一天走在回家路上时，三名面目狰狞的暴徒突然将你堵在了死角。看架势他们竟想置你于死地——可究竟为什么？！千钧一发之际，两名少女及时现身救下了你。依靠其中一人的力量突出重围吧——而一场意想不到的恋情，也将随之悄然萌芽。

[摘自[url=https://writer31.itch.io/running-with-you]itch.io[/url]]
